matched: Fundamental value is insufficient protection when crowded exposures become correlated and liquidity disappears. → The events of this summer serve as a stark reminder that in a regime defined by systemic stress, our 'hedged' structures are only as robust as the liquidity of the underlying assets.

Reduce the chance that funding or redemptions force sales before event value can be realized. → Thin liquidity and rising market volatility increase the risk of forced liquidation at distressed prices before event catalysts can play out.

Preserve the ability to redeploy into distressed opportunities rather than defend every prior mark. → Preserving capital to deploy into higher-conviction, post-reorganization, or distressed situations as the cycle progresses is preferable to riding out systemic beta risk.
